full_name: Patrick Keating | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2014–2015 Humanities ACLS Frederick Burkhardt Fellow Trinity University (Texas)
bio: Patrick Keating is an associate professor of communication at Trinity University, where he teaches courses in film and media studies. His primary research is in the history of cinematography with an emphasis on the cultural significance of visual style, drawing on methodologies from cinema studies, American studies, and art history.
